title: Great visual tracking, needs better weekly habit support
body: Great app for visual habit tracking and staying motivated. However, it needs better support for habits that are done only a few times per week or once a week. The calendar and summary views should highlight only the scheduled days instead of showing all days, or even only the 52 weeks. The visual consistency is what makes habit tracking motivating, and preserving that harmony is more important than the streak number itself.
